_doc: Behavioral field defaults from NPC._load_npc_data(). A field omitted from an NPC JSON file takes this value. group_member_schema documents the structure of members arrays in group NPC files (M25-9).

group_member_schema._doc: Each entry in the 'members' array of a group NPC file such as goblins.json.
group_member_schema.npc_id: string — required, ID of the NPC to spawn
group_member_schema.weight: int — relative probability weight for random selection
group_member_schema.count: int or null — exact count; null means derive from min_count/max_count
group_member_schema.min_count: int or null — minimum spawn count when count is null
group_member_schema.max_count: int or null — maximum spawn count when count is null
